annotations.title: Set the venue text and amenities

description: Sets the description of the place shown at the top of the booking page, and the venue-wide amenities. Only the fields sent are changed. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

amenities.description: Venue amenity keys (the venue_amenities list of this venue’s stay options). Replaces the current list.
